        previous_slow = self.slow.Current.Value if self.slow.IsReady else None

            return
        if not self.fast.IsReady or not self.slow.IsReady:
            return

        bullish_cross = (
            previous_fast <= previous_slow and
            self.fast.Current.Value > self.slow.Current.Value
        )

        end_time = bar.EndTime.time()

        if bullish_cross and eligible_time:

        ]

            candidates,

        )[0]

        self.entry_ticket = self.MarketOrder(selected.Symbol, 1)

            return
        if self.exit_ticket is not None and self.exit_ticket.Status not in (

        if self.held_contract is None:

            OrderStatus.Invalid,

            return

            )
            self.Debug("Submitted SPY call exit: " + reason)

            OrderStatus.Submitted,
            OrderStatus.PartiallyFilled

                    self.time_stop_date = self._previous_trading_day(expiry)

        ):
            self.expiration_guard_date = today
            self.CancelOpenExitOrder()
            self.exit_ticket = self.Liquidate(self.entry_symbol)
            self.Debug(
                f"Pre-expiration exit submitted: {self.entry_symbol.Value}"
            )

    def CancelOpenExitOrder(self):
        if self.exit_ticket is None:
            return

        if self.exit_ticket.Status in [
            OrderStatus.New,
            OrderStatus.Submitted,
            OrderStatus.PartiallyFilled
        ]:
            self.Transactions.CancelOrder(self.exit_ticket.OrderId)

    def HandleEquityAssignment(self, slice: Slice):
        if not self.Portfolio[self.spy_symbol].Invested:
            return

        if self.Portfolio[self.spy_symbol].Quantity == 0:
            return

        self.Liquidate(self.spy_symbol)
        self.Debug("Unexpected SPY exercise or assignment handled.")

    def OnOrderEvent(self, order_event: OrderEvent):
        if (
            self.entry_ticket is not None
            and order_event.OrderId == self.entry_ticket.OrderId
        ):
            if order_event.Status == OrderStatus.Filled:
                self.entry_price = order_event.FillPrice
                self.Debug(
                    f"Call entry filled: {self.entry_symbol.Value}, "
                    f"price {self.entry_price:.2f}"
                )

            elif order_event.Status in [
                OrderStatus.Canceled,
                OrderStatus.Invalid
            ]:
                self.Debug("Call entry order did not fill.")
                self.entry_ticket = None
                self.entry_symbol = None
                self.entry_price = None

        if order_event.IsAssignment:
            self.Debug("Unexpected option exercise or assignment received.")
            if self.Portfolio[self.spy_symbol].Invested:
                self.Liquidate(self.spy_symbol)
